name: SAR RSI MTS
summary: This EA combines Parabolic SAR direction changes with RSI momentum confirmation to generate trend-following trade signals on new bar formation. It opens buy positions when SAR flips below price and RSI is rising above 50, and sell positions when SAR flips above price and RSI is falling below 50. Position sizing uses fixed margin risk percentage with trailing stop management for open trades.
summary_zh: 该EA结合抛物线SAR方向变化与RSI动量确认，在新K线形成时生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当SAR翻转到价格下方且RSI上穿50时开多仓，当SAR翻转到价格上方且RSI下穿50时开空仓。仓位管理使用固定保证金风险百分比，并对持仓进行移动止损管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA是一个典型的趋势跟踪系统，利用Parabolic SAR判断趋势方向翻转，同时用RSI作为动量过滤器确认趋势强度。入场条件：做多需满足四个条件——前一根SAR值低于收盘价（SAR在价格下方）、SAR值从前一根到当前根递增（确认SAR翻转向上追踪趋势）、当前RSI大于50（多头动量确认）、当前RSI大于前一根RSI（动量增强确认）；做空条件对称相反。出场条件：采用固定止损和止盈（10点止损/40点止盈），以及移动止损（15点跟踪止损+5点步进），当价格朝有利方向移动超过跟踪止损加步进距离时调整止损。仓位管理：使用CMoneyFixedMargin类根据风险百分比（默认1%）和可用保证金计算开仓手数，同时通过CTrade.CheckVolume进行预检以避免资金不足错误。资金管理：最多允许同时持有6个同策略仓位，止损止盈均以点数输入并自动适配3/5位报价。移动止损对多空仓位分别处理，确保止损只朝有利方向移动。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA is a classic trend-following system that uses Parabolic SAR to detect trend direction reversals and RSI as a momentum filter to confirm trend strength. Entry conditions: Long entry requires four conditions — previous SAR below close price (SAR beneath price), SAR increasing from previous to current bar (confirming SAR flip tracking the trend), current RSI above 50 (bullish momentum confirmation), and current RSI higher than previous RSI (momentum acceleration confirmation); short entry conditions are symmetrically opposite. Exit conditions: Fixed stop loss and take profit (10 pips SL / 40 pips TP), plus a trailing stop (15 pips trailing stop + 5 pips step) that adjusts the stop loss when price moves favorably beyond the trailing distance plus step increment. Position sizing: Uses CMoneyFixedMargin class to calculate lot size based on risk percentage (default 1%) and available free margin, with a pre-check via CTrade.CheckVolume to avoid insufficient margin errors. Money management: Allows up to 6 simultaneous positions for the same strategy, with SL/TP input in pips auto-adjusted for 3/5 digit brokers. The trailing stop handles long and short positions separately, ensuring stops only move in the favorable direction.

pros: SAR与RSI双重确认减少假信号，逻辑清晰合理
使用固定保证金风险百分比进行仓位计算，资金管理较为规范
移动止损机制能锁定浮盈，保护已有利润
新K线检测避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易
最多6个持仓限制提供了一定的仓位上限控制
pros_en: Dual confirmation from SAR and RSI reduces false signals with clear logical structure
Fixed margin risk percentage for position sizing provides disciplined money management
Trailing stop mechanism locks in floating profits and protects gains
New bar detection prevents duplicate entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Maximum 6 position limit provides a reasonable cap on concurrent exposure
cons: 止损仅10点偏小，在H1周期上容易因市场噪音被扫损
止盈止损比率为4:1虽然合理，但10点止损在高波动品种上几乎必被触发
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上开仓可能立即处于亏损
SAR在震荡市中频繁翻转会产生大量假信号导致连续亏损
CompareDoubles使用m_symbol.Digits()对RSI比较不合理，RSI是0-100的值而Digits是价格精度
6个同时持仓可能导致在震荡行情中积累大量反向仓位
cons_en: 10-pip stop loss is too tight for H1 timeframe, easily triggered by market noise
4:1 reward-to-risk ratio is reasonable but 10-pip SL is almost guaranteed to be hit on volatile pairs
No spread filter — opening positions on high-spread pairs may immediately be in loss
SAR frequently flips in ranging markets, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
CompareDoubles uses m_symbol.Digits() for RSI comparison which is incorrect — RSI ranges 0-100 while Digits reflects price precision
6 concurrent positions can accumulate significant adverse exposure during choppy market conditions
improvements: 修复CompareDoubles对RSI的比较逻辑，应使用固定小数位（如2位）而非价格Digits来比较RSI值
增加点差过滤和震荡市识别（如ADX过滤），避免在不利条件下开仓
止损点数应根据ATR动态计算，而非固定点数，以适应不同波动环境
improvements_en: Fix CompareDoubles logic for RSI comparison — should use a fixed decimal precision (e.g., 2 digits) instead of price Digits for comparing RSI values
Add spread filter and ranging market detection (e.g., ADX filter) to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Stop loss should be dynamically calculated based on ATR rather than fixed pips to adapt to different volatility environments

risk_points: 止损过小（10点）在H1周期上极易被扫损，导致频繁小额亏损
CompareDoubles函数对RSI的比较精度使用价格Digits存在逻辑缺陷，可能导致信号判断错误
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下开仓成本侵蚀利润
6个同时持仓在震荡市中可能累积较大风险敞口
risk_points_en: Tight 10-pip stop loss on H1 timeframe is easily triggered, causing frequent small losses
CompareDoubles function uses price Digits for RSI comparison which is logically flawed and may cause incorrect signal judgment
No spread filter means opening costs erode profits on high-spread instruments
6 concurrent positions can accumulate significant risk exposure during choppy markets
